BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to property tax statements; and amending RCW84.56.022.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 84.56.022 and 1995 c 180 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: ((Each)) (1) Tax statements shall show the amount of ((voterapproved)): (((1))) (a) Regular levies ((except those authorized inRCW 84.55.050)), by taxing district; and (((2))) (b) excess levies, bytaxing district. Such amounts may be shown either as a dollar amountor as a percentage of the total amount of taxes. (2) If a taxpayer, as shown by the tax rolls, holds solely asecurity interest in the real property as described in RCW 84.40.045,the county treasurer shall provide the person making payments to thetaxpayer a copy of the tax statement; however, the copy must clearlyindicate that it is not a bill for collection of property taxes.
